children: As XRP continues to pull strong price moves amid its strongest quarter of the year, traders are increasingly regaining their confidence in the leading altcoin.
Although XRP has briefly cooled from its recent price rally, momentum is still building and traders on Kalshi are betting on the asset breaking a major resistance soon.
According to the latest data showcased on the Kalshi prediction market, traders on the platform have predicted that XRP is most likely to hit $1.70 this month.
The prediction came a few days after XRP finally broke resistance around $1.6 after multiple months of consistently trading below that level.
Following this price rally, XRP has retained bullish sentiments from investors, sparking renewed interest after multiple months of extreme volatility.

With traders on Kalshi betting on XRP reaching $1.70 before the month runs out while the asset is trading at $1.53 as of the time of writing, it means that XRP would need to surge by over 11% in the next three days to hit the $1.70 target.
While September marks the last month of the third quarter of 2026, it has extended the bullish performance seen last month, causing it to achieve the highest quarterly gain seen this year.
Notably, latest onchain data shows that XRP has surged by about 47.6% in the third quarter of 2026. This marks a major recovery after two consecutive quarters of losses.
